verdict.rationale: telli is an AI voice-agent platform, so end-of-turn detection is a fair axis to judge it on. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions turn detection, VAD settings, interruption handling, or model-based end-of-turn prediction. The items cover workflows, webhooks, telephony, voice cloning and testing, none of which address turn-taking.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use model-based end-of-turn detection beyond simple VAD silence timeouts so the agent doesn't talk over slow speakers
